lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [epic, building] The Central Bank of Robux was one giant obby.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [fast, commentator] Coin avalanches! Floors made of price tags that went UP while you stood on them! Laser scanners that charged you a fee just for LOOKING at them!

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: [chirpy] Scan complete! Fee: one hat.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: [outraged] NOT THE BERET!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [straining] A wall of bills! A conveyor belt of debt! And a coin avalanche right on top of—

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [shouts] MIA! Grab my hand!

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: [coughing, then quietly] ...Thanks. [pause] Don't tell anyone I said that.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [fast, panicked] And then... the Thirty Percent Guy's interns showed up. Hundreds of tiny Thirty Percent Guys!

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [tiny, many voices, chaotic] Fee! Fee! Fee! Fee! Fee!

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.text: [panicked] They're taking thirty percent of my SOCK!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [awed] At the very top... the Robux Printer. [pause] And guarding it...

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [giant, booming] Every coin! Every trade! Every SANDWICH! Thirty percent belongs to ME!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [scared] He's too big! We can't beat him!

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.text: [suddenly brave] Wait. [pause] I have an idea.

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.text: Hey, Mister Thirty. I want to buy something. [pause] For twelve Robux.

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [greedy, booming] A purchase?! Marketplace fee! Thirty percent of twelve is...

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [calculating, slowing down] Three... point... six.

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [panicking] Three point SIX?! But Robux don't have DECIMALS!

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [glitching, robotic stutter] Does not compute... does not COMPUTE!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [laughing, disbelief] Pickle... you beat him with MATH!

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.text: [proud] I never skipped math class.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: [snorts] Burn.
